{{Quote|My previous experience writing in a galaxy far, far away—STAR WARS: DARTH MAUL – BLACK, WHITE & RED—was an absolute delight. But those were one-shots. Flirtations with the franchise. With SHADOW OF MAUL, I'm able to share a more expansive story about one of my favorite characters, while also exploring a fresh angle on the ''Star Wars'' universe.|Benjamin Percy|<ref name="Reveal" />}}
'''''Star Wars: Shadow of Maul''''' is a [[2026]] [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries that serves as a prequel to the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord]]''. The series was written by [[Benjamin Percy]], illustrated by [[Madibek Musabekov]], with the [[Shadow of Maul 1|first issue]] published by [[Marvel Comics]] on [[March 4]], 2026.
